parts.name: Avatar
parts.description: An image with initials as fallback. Native span attributes and ref apply to the wrapper; name determines its accessible label.

props.name: name
props.description: Accessible image name and source of up to two fallback initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Missing or failed images fall back to initials.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
